text:
Maya Ortiz: Dropping the NebulaGrid co-marketing bundle here. Need quick checks: logo lockups for Azure marketplace tile, accessible alt text for hero, and signoff language for the customer story quote. Partner supplied vector files: https://nebula.example.com/assets/bundle.zip

Tom Becker: Looking now. Their wordmark has tight letterspacing; at 240x240 the thin joins disappear. Suggest using their stacked emblem for the tile and a horizontal lockup for hero. Will prep SVG variants.

Priya Shah: Marketplace specs reminder: Azure hero 1200x627, GCP tile 300x300, AWS thumbnail 600x315. We should standardize on 72dpi PNGs and have a 36px safe margin. Can we also get an alt text that mentions the joint solution benefit?

Maya Ortiz: Partner draft quote: "NebulaGrid and Redwood cut average inference latency by 22% across our validation set." Legal will need attribution (name/title/company) and validated baseline.

LegalBot: Flag: "cut average inference latency by 22%" = empirical claim. Please include the validation dataset and timeframe in the approval email from NebulaGrid. Also provide trademark notice for NebulaGrid: "NebulaGrid™ is a trademark of NebulaGrid, Inc." We'll include a one-line consent: "NebulaGrid consents to use of its name and logo in Redwood marketing materials."

Alex (NebulaGrid): Confirmed: baseline is internal pre-integration benchmarks from May 2025; validation set is 10k inference requests across mixed payloads. PM will send an approval email with attribution by EOD. Alt text suggestion: "NebulaGrid + Redwood joint solution brief cover highlighting 22% latency reduction in validation tests."

Tom Becker: Uploaded exports: https://redwood.assets.internal/nebulagrid/exports_v2.zip contains hero/tiles/favicon, plus a high-contrast SVG set and a stacked emblem for small sizes. Also included a 1px outline variant for dark backgrounds.

Priya Shah: For accessibility, tweak alt to avoid acronyms and be descriptive: "Cover image: NebulaGrid and Redwood Inference solution brief showing a 22% reduction in inference latency on validation tests." That reads better for screen readers.

Maya Ortiz: Good call. Next steps: 1) @Tom finalize the PNGs for each marketplace and upload to marketplace/images/nebulagrid. 2) @Priya hold the case quote until we have the partner email and add full attribution. 3) @LegalBot prepare the trademark consent snippet and signature request. Target: Tuesday noon. Any blockers?

Tom Becker: No blockers. Will push images and ping when available.

LegalBot: Starting signature flow now, will post copy to review.

Alex (NebulaGrid): Email with metric details sent to Priya and Legal, includes PM signature. Happy to approve the alt text change.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks all. React with :thumbsup: when your task is complete so I can package the final assets into the partner folder for the co-launch checklist.
